text:
maria (product): Quick sync — Acme pilot asked for private deployment with HSM + SLA. Need cross-team plan by EOD tomorrow. Main asks: p95 SLA target, KMS/HSM proof, dedicated burst capacity for demo.
kevin (runtime): Got it. What model sizes / max seq? KV cache behavior will change perf a lot. Also need 1 perf engineer for batching tweaks.
maria (product): Model is 7B dense for now, burst qps ~120 req/s during demo. Success criteria: p95 < 150ms for typical prompt, no PII leakage, canary rollout.
anya (infra): For private deploy we need VPC peering + egress rules. I need CIDR ranges + expected egress endpoints. Also: who signs the capacity commit?
sam (security): HSM evaluation: we need threat model doc + list of keys used. If HSM is mandatory, timelines shift — planning ~2 weeks for procurement/eval unless we use cloud KMS with attestation.
leah (sre): Canary plan: start with 5% traffic, monitor error budget and latency. Prewarm pools 15 minutes before demo to avoid cold-start tail. Also add automatic fallback to smaller quant model on p99 latency spike.
kevin (runtime): Proposal: dedicated reserved pool (2 GPUs) + quantized variant as fallback. Runtime changes: enable prefix KV caching and strict batching window of 40ms. Canary rollout yaml (wip):
```
rollout:
  canary_percent: 5
  metrics: [p95_latency, error_rate]
  fallback: model-7b-quant
```
anya (infra): Ok that config is doable. But to reserve GPUs for a customer pilot we need a signed commit or internal approval. Can product confirm budget holder?
maria (product): I'll get PO and budget owner today. If we can't reserve, we'll need a soft SLA and stricter fallbacks.
sam (security): If PO includes HSM, we need the vendor attestation and who has key access. Otherwise security sign-off will block. Also request: endpoint/ingress network diagram.
kevin (runtime): Action items from runtime: 1) bench 7B quant fallback; 2) wire KV caching defaults; 3) add canary monitor dashboard. I estimate 3-4 work days across 2 engineers.
leah (sre): I'll draft the canary runbook and rollback playbook. Need an oncall owner for the demo window.
maria (product): I'll own coordination and customer comms. Timeline: internal readiness review in 48h, security signoff in 72h, final go/no-go 24h before demo.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: INFRA-4221 "Acme private pilot VPC + capacity reserve" — assignee: anya.
anya (infra): I picked up INFRA-4221 and added checklist: CIDR, peering, egress, reserved instance request. Please add PO number to ticket.
sam (security): I'll slot HSM review into my calendar for Thursday morning if I get the vendor docs today.
kevin (runtime): I'll post preliminary perf numbers in INFRA-4221 thread by EOD.
maria (product): thanks all — can everyone react with :thumbsup: when you've added the required doc to the ticket? We'll follow up in the readiness review.
kevin (runtime): :thumbsup:
anya (infra): :thumbsup: added CIDR ranges
sam (security): :thumbsup: will add vendor attestation
leah (sre): :thumbsup: runbook draft done
maria (product): Great — closing this thread, will spin up a short sync if blockers pop.
